visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and a red t-shirt stands in a well-lit room, holding two cushion foundation products. Behind her is a white shelf filled with luxury handbags and collectibles. She smiles and talks to the camera. (2) The camera focuses on a black, quilted-texture cushion foundation labeled '&be'. The woman's manicured hands are seen holding and rotating the product. (3) The focus shifts to a simple, off-white cushion foundation labeled 'Excel'. The background remains the same studio-like setting. (4) The woman, now wearing a white plush headband, applies the black &be cushion to the right side of her face using a puff. She dabs the product carefully while looking at her reflection. (5) She applies the white Excel cushion to the left side of her face. The lighting highlights the difference in skin texture and finish between the two sides. (6) She gestures to both sides of her face, comparing the results. She points to her nose to show pore coverage and then touches her cheeks to demonstrate the product's durability. She concludes by holding both products and giving her final recommendation.

(6) [Subtitle]: 上起來是更內斂一點的柔霧光. (7) [Subtitle]: 兩款都算是中等. (8) [Subtitle]: 遮毛孔效果明顯是比較優秀的. (9) [Subtitle]: 都有成膜效果的. (10) [Subtitle]: 不容易沾染. (11) [Subtitle]: &be 獲勝. (12) [Subtitle]: 顏值跟整個妝感的細膩度我都覺得更勝一籌. (13) [Subtitle]: 我用的是 1 號色.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comparative review of two popular Japanese drugstore cushion foundations, &be and Excel. The creator evaluates them based on packaging, texture, finish, pore-concealing ability, and durability to help viewers make an informed purchasing decision.
